type get_mol_mr = (_: {

// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Bertz complexity index.
type get_bertz_ct = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_ipc = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_kappa1 = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Kappa2 shape index.
type get_kappa2 = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_kappa3 = (_: {

}) => any;

}) => any;
